stories.title: Leading the Way
stories.detail: Minor premiership form from Max O'Connell, 20 pts on the board and the rest of the field playing for second.

stories.title: The Bolter
stories.detail: 12 spots and plenty of smiles, Ken Child charged home like a side playing proper finals footy.

stories.title: Welcome to WWCC
stories.detail: Cheers to Garry Atkinson from Yass GC for making the drive, come back and do it again soon.

stories.title: Reachable Feeling
stories.detail: 2 of the par 5s gave up 3-pointers - length is a weapon

stories.title: Steady Eddie
stories.detail: 6 two-pointers, not a wipe in sight - metronomic golf

stories.title: Not Done Yet
stories.detail: Wipe on hole 4, 3-pointer on hole 5 - that's better

stories.title: Brief Interruption
stories.detail: Back-to-back wipes on holes 6 & 7 - we'll pretend this didn't happen

stories.title: Variety Pack
stories.detail: Wipes, 1s, 2s, 3s - something for everyone on this card

stories.title: The Complete Package
stories.detail: Wipes, 1s, 2s AND 3s - a round that covers all four food groups

stories.title: Settling In
stories.detail: 3 twos in a row on holes 12, 13 & 14 - starting to look comfortable

stories.title: Building Something
stories.detail: 3 twos on holes 5, 6 & 7 - the round is taking shape

stories.title: Going Rogue
stories.detail: Back-to-back on holes 11 & 12 - the field is on notice

stories.title: Speed Bump
stories.detail: 3-pointer on hole 5, wipe on hole 6 - the course corrects

stories.title: The Golf Tax Strikes Again
stories.detail: 3-pointer to 1-pointer on holes 13 & 14 - the course always takes its cut
